svg.title: Speculative decoding: a small model guesses tokens and a big model checks them in one pass
svg.text: Speculative decoding, one verify pass at a time
Qwen3-0.6B guesses the next 4 tokens, and Qwen3-1.7B checks all 4 in a single forward pass. It keeps the guesses up to the first miss, then adds one token of its own.
Prompt: In three sentences, explain why the sky is blue.
tokens gained per pass of the big model
48 tokens from 16 big-model passes, 3.00 per pass instead of 1
